author: swage45641
quote: Great freeroam and amazing gameplay, I love the overall playing of the game and everything surronding it, but the story is ass, how did we go from robbing banks to painting walls, and not being able to rob cars becuase of a mental distress. The game is forced to be the Sims 6 not GTA 6. GAMEPLAY 10/10 but the forced story and lack of freedom, -8/10.
